The docking station automatically opens and closes to fully enclose the drone. The docking station automatically charges the drone. Also notice: One drone for each docking station. Drone can take off and land autonomously to the docking station, docking station closes around the drone to protect it from weather, the batteries are charged/swapped automatically by the dock, data from previous fights will be uploaded to cloud either directly from the drone or via the docking station.
